header.title: Pprof Profiler
header.subtitle: Development only - Runtime profiling and memory analysis

leaks.title: Potential Leaks
leaks.description: Stacks whose live bytes remain a large fraction of what they ever allocated (retention), optionally with live bytes trending upward over the last minute. Growth + high retention together is the strongest leak signal.
leaks.empty: No obvious leak signatures; all live allocations have normal retention ratios.

inuse.title: Live Heap Allocations
inuse.description: Call stacks currently holding memory on the heap right now. Expand a row to see the full stack.

cumulative.title: Cumulative Memory Allocations
cumulative.description: Total bytes allocated since process start (includes memory already freed). Expand a row to see the full stack.

goroutines.title: Goroutine Health
goroutines.allHidden: All goroutines are hidden. Click "Clear hidden" to show them.

states.error: Failed to load profiling data. Make sure the backend is running in dev mode.
